title: RAW: legal-menu words end at the first WAIT or ROTATE while resource state carries across words
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. A separate complete boundary variant of IDEA1054 preserves its five-container legal-action rank code but removes freely supplied phase lengths. Each source word is zero or more legal MOVE actions followed by exactly one WAIT or ROTATE; the writer inserts a gap at that first terminating action. The reader recovers the ordered actions and uniquely generated word boundaries while carrying the inventory. This entails at most10 terminal drawing ranks, only8 of which may also be word-internal. No native values, fit, count, source language or historical use is claimed;1054 remains unchanged.

design.scope: One complete explicitly framed source paragraph, fixed initial inventory, one global22-drawing rank alphabet, no internal resets, no arbitrary phase lengths and no silent termination. This is a restricted informational instruction language, not general prose.
design.mechanism: Recompute a small legal-action menu from the current resource counts. Write the rank of each actual source action. MOVE continues the current word; WAIT and ROTATE necessarily end it. State survives the inserted word boundary.
design.unit: One drawing encodes one actual source action. A whole written word encodes one uniquely delimited episode MOVE* followed by WAIT or ROTATE. A word is not an arbitrary output-bank entry or an unassigned whole function.
design.contrast: IDEA1054 preserves independently supplied source-phase boundaries. Here only the action semantics determine the boundaries. GDT1326's identical reset after each group is absent; IDEA997's first modular target hit is a different stopping and source-content rule.
design.prediction: At occupancy k, exactly4k MOVE actions are legal, followed by WAIT at rank4k and ROTATE at4k+1. Since1<=k<=5, every complete word ends at one of ten ranks4,5,8,9,12,13,16,17,20,21. Ranks20 and21 can never occur internally; only eight terminal-capable ranks may also be internal.

source_domain.identities: Exactly five taught containers A,B,C,D,E. These labels name source objects only; they are not Voynich glyph or word values.
source_domain.initial: Every explicitly framed source paragraph begins with inventory(1,1,1,1,1) and waiting count0. This is a fixed source convention, not a freely fitted initial state. Paragraphs are nonempty.
source_domain.state: Five nonnegative integer counts with conserved sum5, plus an elapsed WAIT count. The WAIT count does not alter menu ordering.

actions.MOVE(X,Y): X and Y are distinct; X must be nonempty. Remove one unit from X and add it to Y.
actions.WAIT: Add exactly one declared waiting unit to the waiting count; do not change inventory.

source_domain.paragraph_grammar: A finite legal flat action trace with at least one action, ending in WAIT or ROTATE. Partition it at EVERY WAIT/ROTATE. Equivalently each source word is MOVE* (WAIT|ROTATE). No MOVE-only final fragment, empty word or omitted terminator is legal.
source_domain.information_preserved: The exact named action trace, order, repeated actions, paragraph boundaries and generated episode boundaries. Waiting and rotation are real source actions, even when they leave a chosen material state unchanged. Final-state equality does not erase their written occurrences.
source_domain.outside_domain: Other containers, amounts, actions, spontaneous creation/destruction, arbitrary names, language prose and unmarked changes of initial stock are rejected. There is no unpriced escape branch.

shared_apparatus.drawings: Exactly22 distinct abstract atomic drawings D0,...,D21. Labels Dn are explanatory notation, not multi-character physical spellings. Any future native use requires ONE global bijection, not a map per word/page.
shared_apparatus.menu: Delete only MOVE entries with an empty source container; preserve the order of all remaining entries. WAIT and ROTATE remain the final two entries. Number the menu from0.
shared_apparatus.cost: Five named containers,22 rank drawings, the fixed20-pair order, the three explicit action rules and five small counters. A126-state lookup table is unnecessary because the menu is computed, but the running inventory is real reader work. No output-word dictionary, learned frequency table or hidden semantic memory is free.

forward: Initialize once at the explicit paragraph start. Verify the source trace belongs to the declared grammar.
For each actual action, construct the legal menu, write its rank drawing, and execute the action.
If the action is MOVE, continue the same word. If it is WAIT or ROTATE, end the word immediately and insert a gap if another episode follows.
Carry inventory and waiting count across every word gap. Physical line wrapping is allowed only at these gaps and causes no reset.
End the paragraph only after a terminating action. Do not append a WAIT/ROTATE to an incomplete source to make it encodable.
reader: Initialize the public inventory at the explicit paragraph start. Ordinary gaps and single layout wraps are candidate word boundaries, not resets.
At each drawing D_r, rebuild the legal menu. Reject an out-of-range rank. Recover and execute its exact named action.

Require every nonfinal drawing within a visible word to decode as MOVE. Require its final drawing to decode as WAIT or ROTATE. Reject an early terminating action inside a word or a visible word ending in MOVE.
Preserve every source action and carry its result across the gap. Require a nonempty paragraph ending with a complete word.

Induction on actions gives equal writer/reader inventories and the same selected action at every rank. WAIT/ROTATE positions determine the same unique word boundaries. Thus the inverse returns the entire source trace, not merely its final state.

source_only_hand_examples.reason: Initially rank16 is E->A. It empties E, leaving k=4; WAIT is now rank16 and closes the word. The first16 is internal and the second terminal under the same global drawing map.
All five containers remain occupied. Each WAIT closes its own word; three occurrences and three waiting units remain explicit.
The second move restores all five occupied containers, so the terminating WAIT returns to rank20. Original1054's freely supplied split after the second MOVE would be illegal in this variant.

source_only_hand_examples.source_family: From the public initial inventory, perform n repeats of the current rank0 MOVE, then WAIT.
source_only_hand_examples.output: For even n, D0^n D20; for odd n, D0^n D16.
source_only_hand_examples.reason: Rank0 alternates A->B and B->A in this particular trace. The parity affects occupancy5versus4 and thus the terminal WAIT spelling. This is a source-only illustration, not a native e-run interpretation or measured family.

terminal_bound_proof.occupancy: Conserved positive total5 implies k in{1,2,3,4,5}. Each nonempty source permits four MOVE destinations, hence4klegal moves.
terminal_bound_proof.internal_union: All internal actions are MOVE, so their ranks lie in0..19. In the initial k=5 state every rank0..19 is a legal move, establishing the generous internal union.
terminal_bound_proof.consequence: At most10 globally distinct drawings can end complete words;20/21are terminal-only; at most8 drawing identities can occur both internally and terminally. A global bijective relabeling preserves all three capacities.
terminal_bound_proof.qualification: These are necessary upper bounds, not proof that every permitted pattern is globally reachable. No native ending census or solver is executed in this producer block. Existing terminal-inventory evidence can be reviewed separately by root before any larger implementation.

design.whole_passage_consequence: Every complete paragraph must have one prefix-consistent inventory trace from the same initial state. A proposed word boundary has a deterministic semantic check in that trace. The same visible prefix may continue from one carried inventory and terminate from another, so isolated word admission cannot replace whole-paragraph replay.
limits: This source-language grammar is deliberately restrictive. It is not evidence that a Voynich word is a transfer episode, WAIT, ROTATE or an instruction.
There is no canonical common end inventory and no fixed increment for each drawing independent of its state. Common-endpoint/additive exclusions need their own premises.
A native paragraph/word/working-unit binding is hypothetical. No uncertain seam, split group, source reset or extra termination is supplied to save a case.
The formal rule permits arbitrarily long MOVE sequences and exact repeated whole words. This does not establish compatibility with all observed repetitions or predict their rates.
The terminal cap is a substantial known obligation. The variant must not be described as native-compatible merely because its inverse is complete.
Original1054's unbound phase grouping remains exactly as recorded. Failure or success of this new restricted variant would not rewrite that source contract.
No GDT1390 failure, secret control or recovery output determined these action rules. This is an independently proposed semantic boundary rule, not a repair of cumulative modular recovery.

predecessor_review.difference: Same complete source actions/menu/state apparatus; changed source domain and boundary rule eliminate independently supplied phase lengths. Original remains unchanged.
Its proof requires the same reset state after every gap. Here the inventory carries, so the prefix/no-prefix theorem does not automatically transfer. No claim that this makes the new carrier fit.

A modular random walk stops at a source target residue; this deterministic writer stops at an actual WAIT/ROTATE instruction under a restricted semantic source grammar. No first-hit length result is changed.
Fixed relation-path controls and their one-sign capacity are a different carrier. Their retained limits are not repaired by the state-dependent terminal ranks here.
The full carried five-count inventory, rather than only the previous whole word, is explicitly paid state. No deterministic previous-word-only result is reopened.
